text:
**Data Engineer, Logistics**

We're a logistics startup with 60 people, and we just raised a $12M Series A. We're hiring a Data Engineer to build the pipelines that help packages arrive on time and on budget.

Our stack is dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. You'll design pipelines that scale, improve our data models, and get reliable data to teams across the company so they can make decisions with it.

The team is small, so your work will show up quickly. There isn't much process to get through, and you'll have room to decide how things get built.

You'll work remotely 4 days a week.

If you like hard data problems and want to work on how goods move around the world, we'd like to hear from you.
